title: Practice Quiz
instructions: This is a practice quiz so you can get used to the system before the real exam. You can retake it as many times as you like, and you'll see your score at the end. Activity is logged, just like the real exam.

questions.text: To move to the next question in this quiz, which button do you use?

options.text: The Next button at the bottom

questions.text: You can revisit an earlier question using the Back button before you submit.
What happens when the timer reaches zero?
During the real exam you should stay on the exam page and not switch to other tabs.
If you finish early, how do you hand in your answers?

options.text: Wait for time to run out
